tool_definitions.name: check_stock
tool_definitions.description: Check stock: Use this to check available quantity and reorder point for a product by name or SKU. Do not use this tool for changing stock or placing an order. Inputs include a readable customer or product name when relevant; output labels are designed for a user to recognize the matching record. Errors identify a field and safe next step. Results are bounded, and continuation metadata is included when more results exist.

product.description: Product name or SKU, e.g. Harju 80 sauna heater

tool_definitions.name: find_account
tool_definitions.description: Find account: Use this to resolve a customer from its legal or trading name and view its account status. Do not use this tool for searching invoices or changing an account. Inputs include a readable customer or product name when relevant; output labels are designed for a user to recognize the matching record. Errors identify a field and safe next step. Results are bounded, and continuation metadata is included when more results exist.

name.description: Customer legal or trading name, e.g. Kelo Hotels Oy

tool_definitions.name: place_order
tool_definitions.description: Place reviewed order: Use this only after the user has reviewed a preview and explicitly asked to place it. Do not use this tool for drafting, editing, or cancelling an order. Do not use this tool for {}. Inputs include a readable customer or product name when relevant; output labels are designed for a user to recognize the matching record. Errors identify a field and safe next step. Results are bounded, and continuation metadata is included when more results exist.

confirmation.description: Required confirmation value after the user approves this exact preview

idempotencyKey.description: Client-generated key reused for an exact retry, at least 8 characters

previewId.description: Preview ID returned by preview_order, e.g. PREVIEW-...

tool_definitions.name: preview_order
tool_definitions.description: Preview order: Use this to calculate a draft order and review its customer, items, and total before placement. Do not use this tool for placing or cancelling an order. Inputs include a readable customer or product name when relevant; output labels are designed for a user to recognize the matching record. Errors identify a field and safe next step. Results are bounded, and continuation metadata is included when more results exist.

customer.description: Customer legal or trading name, e.g. Kelo Hotels Oy

tool_definitions.name: search_invoices
tool_definitions.description: Search invoices: Use this to find invoices by readable number, customer name, or payment status. Do not use this tool for creating, sending, or paying an invoice. Inputs include a readable customer or product name when relevant; output labels are designed for a user to recognize the matching record. Errors identify a field and safe next step. Results are bounded, and continuation metadata is included when more results exist.

cursor.description: Continuation cursor returned by a previous page

query.description: Readable invoice number or customer name

tool_definitions.name: search_orders
tool_definitions.description: Search orders: Use this to find order status by order number, customer name, or date range. Do not use this tool for creating, changing, or cancelling an order. Inputs include a readable customer or product name when relevant; output labels are designed for a user to recognize the matching record. Errors identify a field and safe next step. Results are bounded, and continuation metadata is included when more results exist.

cursor.description: Continuation cursor returned by a previous page

fromDate.description: Inclusive start date in YYYY-MM-DD format, e.g. 2026-10-01

query.description: Readable order number or customer name; omit to list recent orders

findings.summary: No mutation annotations (readOnlyHint/destructiveHint/idempotentHint) are visible to the agent for the state-changing place_order tool; whether the gap is in the server or the host is unknown.
findings.why_it_matters: Without agent-visible annotations, clients cannot reliably distinguish the write tool from read tools or apply approval policy.
findings.fix: Publish accurate annotations (place_order: readOnlyHint false, destructiveHint per behavior, idempotentHint true with its key) and confirm the host forwards them.
